name: somto
description: Social app per film e serie TV: PWA, iOS e backend Firebase.

scripts.i18n:check: node scripts/i18n-check-locales.mjs && node scripts/check-i18n-regressions.mjs && node scripts/i18n-coverage.mjs --lang en --gate
scripts.verify:hosting: npm test && npm run check:pwa-modules && npm run check:public
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run deploy:check:staging && npm run verify:hosting && firebase deploy --config firebase.staging.json --project "$(node ./scripts/print-deploy-project.mjs staging)" && npm run smoke:staging
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run deploy:check:prod && npm run verify:hosting && firebase deploy --project "$(node ./scripts/print-deploy-project.mjs prod)" && npm run smoke:prod
scripts.deploy:staging:hosting: npm run deploy:check:staging && npm run verify:hosting && firebase deploy --config firebase.staging.json --only hosting --project "$(node ./scripts/print-deploy-project.mjs staging)" && npm run smoke:staging
scripts.deploy:prod:hosting: npm run deploy:check:prod && npm run verify:hosting && firebase deploy --only hosting --project "$(node ./scripts/print-deploy-project.mjs prod)" && npm run smoke:prod
scripts.e2e: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-2watch --only auth,firestore,storage,hosting "npm run e2e:seed && npm run e2e:run"

author: Paolo Celestini
